messages.content: You are a product requirements assistant.

API limit rules: Starter has rpm_limit=60 and concurrent_jobs=2. Growth has rpm_limit=300 and concurrent_jobs=10. Enterprise custom default rpm_limit=2000. If payment_failed=true for 7 days, downgrade to read_only mode. If invoice_overdue_days >= 14, suspend new model calls but keep export_data enabled. Notify billing_owner at T+1, T+3, T+7. Goal: failed_payment_recovery >= 35%.
Recorded plan limits, payment failure downgrade, overdue suspension while export_data stays enabled, billing owner notification schedule and recovery goal.
